reason: Stage 1b established convergence at epoch 500 under constant learning rate, repaired the clean-correlation gate, and still failed repeatable-peak and same-master geometry gates. This opens the parent protocol's bounded stage-2 branch.

fixed_stage_2_training.paired_run_seeds: Reuse each standard-VAE v1 fold seed for every candidate in that fold.
fixed_stage_2_training.selection_data: 20 strict-core arpls_minmax grouped inner folds only

sequential_stages.fixed: selected architecture, loss, and latent dimension

stage_winner_rule: Prefer candidates satisfying the registered convergence definition. Then sort by passes-all-gates, gate count, registered utility, lower parameter count, and lexical identifier. Reuse an identical earlier candidate rather than retraining it.

quality_confirmation.source: Top two strict-core KL-stage candidates under the registered ranking.
quality_confirmation.gate: Quality chemical balanced accuracy may be at most 0.05 below the candidate's strict-core value.
quality_confirmation.winner_rule: Prefer quality-gate-passing candidates, then the unchanged strict-core ranking.

unchanged_constraints: No outer, field-stress, held-out-domain, or poster result enters selection.
No supervised, contrastive, adversarial, or partitioned latent objective.
